allow: PowerShell(netstat -ano | Select-String ":3000" | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[-1] } | Sort-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\d+$') { taskkill /PID $_ /F 2>$null } })

hooks.command: git add -A; $staged = git diff --cached --name-only 2>$null; if ($staged) { git commit -m 'auto: save changes'; git push origin main 2>$null }
